tools.description: Search US businesses for sale in DealLedger’s public record (observed on brokers’ own websites). Each result gives price, cash flow, observed listing age with evidence, relist signal, broker and the permanent DealLedger URL. total is the full number of matches; page with offset. Business types: rest

tools.name: check_relisting
tools.description: Check whether a business-for-sale listing shows evidence of having been listed before under a different listing. Returns the signal, its confidence and how it was derived. A possible relist is never confirmed proof.
